title: Shipping
description: Shipping and delivery information for an order. Tracks shipping carrier, tracking number, delivery address, shipment date, estimated delivery, and shipping status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shipping record

order_id.description: Foreign key reference to the order being shipped

tracking_number.description: Unique tracking number provided by the shipping carrier for package tracking

carrier.description: Shipping carrier or logistics company (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL, USPS)

status.description: Current shipping status (e.g., pending, shipped, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, failed)

shipped_date.description: Date when the order was shipped and left the warehouse

estimated_delivery.description: Expected delivery date provided by the shipping carrier

address.description: Complete delivery address where the package is being shipped
